definitions.explanation: A young cow that has not yet matured. Also written {仔牛|こうし}.

examples.japanese: {子牛|こうし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|う}まれた→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧。
⟦{牧場|ぼくじょう}→牧場：06103_bokujou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{子牛|こうし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ミルク→ミルク：00284_miruku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦やった→やる：02980_yaru⟧。
examples.english: I gave milk to a calf at the ranch.

examples.japanese: {母牛|ははうし}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{子牛|こうし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧そば⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{離|はな}れよう→離れる：02397_hanareru⟧としなかった。
examples.english: The mother cow would not leave her calf's side.

notes:
A young cow, also written {仔牛|こうし}. Formed from ⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧ (child) + ⟦{牛|うし}→牛：01857_ushi⟧ (cow), with the reading shifting to こうし.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {子牛|こうし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|う}まれる→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧: a calf is born
- {子牛|こうし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{育|そだ}てる→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧: raise a calf
- {子牛|こうし}{肉|にく}: veal

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{牛|うし}→牛：01857_ushi⟧: cow; cattle — the general term, regardless of age
